programme.title: Help! I'm in a Secret Relationship!

programme.title: Boundless
programme.desc: Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

programme.title: Boundless
programme.desc: Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

programme.desc: Starring Jimmy Fallon and hosted by Keke Palmer, the iconic word-guessing game features celebrities teaming up with everyday contestants. programme.desc: Master Wu, who is as wise-cracking as he is wise, leads a fierce team of secret ninja warriors to defeat the evil warlord Garmadon and save Ninjago City. He will need all of his cunning and guile to defeat his enemy.
programme.title: The LEGO NINJAGO Movie

programme.desc: Engaging family tale based on Dick King-Smith's classic story about an orphaned piglet which is adopted by a sheepdog and learns how to herd sheep. Babe at first seems destined to end up on the dining table at Christmas, but the farmer realises that the animal's unusual talent may bring him glory in the sheepdog trials.
programme.title: Babe

programme.desc: Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.
programme.title: Cats & Dogs

programme.desc: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of a rogue cat who dreams of global domination.
programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore

programme.desc: Charlie Bucket comes from a poor family, and spends most of his time dreaming about the chocolate that he loves but usually can't afford. Things change when Willy Wonka, head of the very popular Wonka Chocolate empire, announces a contest in which five gold tickets have been hidden in chocolate bars. Charlie is one of the five kids who find a lucky ticket and goes on a tour of Wonka's chocolate factory.
programme.title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory

programme.desc: Stranded in the wilderness, a mule deer and a domesticated bear try to make their way back to the safety of a town preserve before a hunter catches them.
programme.title: Open Season

programme.desc: Mr Fox plots one more raid on farmers Boggis, Bunce and Bean before he becomes a responsible father figure.
programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox

programme.desc: Story of the chase for a giant rabbit terrorising a town's allotments and vegetable patches days before the annual vegetable-growing competition. As Wallace and his trusty companion are called into action with their pest control business, a dastardly Lord Victor Quartermaine competes to capture the Were-Rabbit and win the heart of a beautiful lady.
programme.title: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit

programme.desc: When Shaun decides to take the day off and have some fun, he gets more than he bargained for. A mix-up with the farmer, a caravan and a very steep hill lead Shaun and the flock to the big city, and it's up to Shaun to return everyone home safely.
programme.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie

programme.desc: When an alien possessing strange powers crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm, Shaun the Sheep quickly makes a new friend. Together they must run from a dangerous organisation who wants to capture the intergalactic visitor.

programme.desc: A dog gains superpowers after his owner is abducted by aliens. Together they battle an evil cat threatening humanity while the dog becomes a famous superhero.

When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

programme.desc: When young adventurer Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an uncharted island, he sets out to find it and rescue its lone inhabitant before seismic shockwaves force the island under the sea and bury its treasures forever.
programme.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island

programme.desc: The lives of Gomez and Morticia Addams are thrown into disarray when a scheming siren attempts to pass off her son as Gomez's long-lost brother Fester. Once installed in the family's spooky mansion, mother and son set their minds on stealing the family fortune.
programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.desc: With Wednesday and Pugsley off to summer camp, a greedy nanny plots to marry and murder wealthy Uncle Fester.
programme.title: Addams Family Values

programme.desc: A four-inch-tall family live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.
programme.title: The Borrowers

programme.desc: Reincarnated as different dogs over the course of five decades, a lovable and devoted canine keeps reuniting with the original owner who cared for it as a young golden retriever puppy.
programme.title: A Dog's Purpose

programme.desc: After moving to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong enters a karate competition -- but his skills alone aren't enough. With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.
programme.title: Karate Kid: Legends

programme.desc: SpongeBob goes on a quest to discover a stolen recipe that takes him to our world, where he tangles with a pirate.
programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water

programme.desc: Tommy and his plucky pals go on a forest adventure in his father's latest invention, the Reptar Wagon.
programme.title: The Rugrats Movie

programme.desc: The children and their bickering family are stranded on a desert island. Fortunately help is at hand from the Thornberry family, who are visiting the island to film a rare snow leopard. Once again, animal-understanding Eliza saves the day.

The instant sibling rivalry must soon be put aside when Tim discovers that Boss Baby is actually a spy on a secret mission, and only he can help thwart a dastardly plot that involves an epic battle between puppies and babies.

He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.
programme.title: Look Who's Talking

programme.desc: A thirtysomething slacker attempts to inject some stability into his life by adopting an impressionable five-year-old.
programme.title: Big Daddy

programme.desc: A group of good-hearted but incompetent misfits enter the police academy, but the instructors there are not going to put up with their pranks.
programme.title: Police Academy

programme.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment

programme.desc: Slapstick farce with the incompetent cops as they set about saving their beloved academy from closure. Cutbacks mean that only one of the two police training schools can stay open, so Commandant Lassard appeals to the motley crew of graduates to come and train new recruits. However, the rival academy intends to sabotage their plans by cutting their training time down to a minimum.

programme.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles

programme.desc: An out-of-work actor dresses in drag for an audition, only to land the female lead in a TV soap. When he becomes the most popular character on the show, he feels compelled to carry the persona into his everyday life. While bringing him phenomenal success as an `actress', life as a woman also has its problems - especially when he falls for an actress with whom he works.
programme.title: Tootsie

programme.desc: A normally well-behaved teenager goes wild while his parents are out of town. In charge at his parents' smart house, the 17-year-old sees the chance to make a fast buck when the prostitute, on the run from a scary pimp, appears at his door. He takes her in, and, following his school's entrepreneurial teachings, lets her turn the house into a brothel.

programme.desc: This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about epic storytelling. From The Shawshank Redemption to Dunkirk, witness unforgettable tales of hope, courage and survival.

programme.title: Tremors

programme.desc: A teenage video-game whiz is recruited as an interstellar fighter pilot by an emissary from a league of planets.
programme.title: The Last Starfighter

programme.desc: Big-budget tale of the battle for survival in a world where dry land has disappeared with the melting of the polar ice caps. One man, who has become amphibious, tries to protect survivors on an artificial atoll made from scrap metal by taking on a gang of marauding pirates. He is also intent on discovering if there is any truth in the myth that there is still some land left above water.
programme.title: Waterworld

programme.desc: On his return from the Crusades, Robin of Locksley learns that his father has been murdered by the tyrannical Sheriff of Nottingham and embarks on a campaign of guerrilla warfare to protect King Richard's throne. Fight scenes are lively and inventive, and a set piece fought under the forest canopy pulls out all the stops.
programme.title: Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves

programme.desc: In an attempt to avenge the violent death of his parents, Bruce Wayne fights to rid the city of crime and in particular, his nemesis the Joker. programme.title: Batman

programme.desc: After Selina Kyle sees more than she should in her boss's office, she has an 'accident', falling from the top floor of the building to the street below. Awoken by the licking of cats, she is surprised to find herself still very much alive. She vows to take revenge on her boss and becomes a female avenger, defending women under attack and providing assistance to Batman's efforts to keep the streets of Gotham safe.
programme.title: Batman Returns

programme.desc: DA Harvey Dent and vengeful scientist The Riddler plan to take down Batman, as Dent wrongly believes that it is Batman's fault he was disfigured, and the scientist is angry with Bruce Wayne for rejecting his experiments. The Gotham City superhero is going to need his new partner, boy wonder Robin, but will he be able to cope with the distraction of sexy doctor Chase Meridian?
programme.title: Batman Forever

programme.desc: Batman battles super-villain Mr Freeze and seductive eco-terrorist Poison Ivy. Based on the book by Stephen King.
programme.title: The Shining

programme.desc: Outlaw Riddick, on the request of the peacemakers, lands on planet New Mecca and comes face to face with the army of Necromongers who are threatening all planets in their path. Their leader, Lord Marshal, wishes to convert all humans to his beliefs, or kill them.

There, he lives out the experiences of Aguilar de Nerha, a distant relative who's also a member of the Assassins, a secret society that fights to protect free will from the power-hungry Templar Order. Transformed by the past, Cal begins to gain the knowledge and physical skills necessary to battle the oppressive organisation in the present.
programme.title: Assassin's Creed

programme.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer

While investigating a series of unregistered close encounters, the MIB agents uncover the deadly plot of an intergalactic terrorist who is on a mission to assassinate two ambassadors from opposing galaxies currently in residence in New York City.

Temi has a broken toe, having mistaken a concrete block for a football. Meanwhile, octogenarian James has a cyst on his knee, but is in so much pain that he's refusing treatment.
programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E

programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.desc: S2 E37 — Seashells Guesthouse The group are off to Great Yarmouth to stay in Sue's dog friendly Seashells Guesthouse. As soon as they pull up, all the guests are blown away by the doggy-themed exterior. The interior is equally memorable, with Paul and Flora finding themselves in the Cappuccino Room and Caroline in the Poppy Room.
programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.desc: S2 E38 — The Old Court Guesthouse In Bath, forthright American ex-banker Nancy Hampson isn't everybody's favourite person. There's trouble from the off for her at The Old Court Guesthouse.
programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.desc: S2 E39 — The Dean The guests head to Scotland to stay with final host Caroline at The Dean Bed and Breakfast. The picturesque house, its two acres of gardens and breathtaking views across the Firth of Forth immediately win everyone over. However, rogue underwear in the drawers and cobwebs on the curtains are touches that the guests aren't so keen on.
programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.desc: S2 E40 — Payment Day There are tensions, tempers and tears as the group reconvene for one last time to thrash out the feedback, reveal the payments and announce the winner in the competition to be named best value B&B of the week. programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.desc: Everyone knows that, each Christmas, Santa Claus delivers presents to every last child on Earth. It's up to Arthur, Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns.

Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.desc: Rachael shows us how to make an impossibly delicious brunch menu of Parm Frittata with tomato sauce, served with a side of sausage and a simple salad that you can serve all day.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Asian chef Kinsan and Laura make Japanese Vegetable Tempura in the Market Kitchen. Laura then prepares Chicken Schnitzel with Mushroom Sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Come spring, Lidia gets very excited to visit the market. The colour, the aromas, that first harvest, it all ignites her creative side to get cooking after a long winter.

programme.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
programme.desc: Hayden dives at sunrise for sea urchins, then he's off to a local farmers' market to buy mushrooms, grab some famous donuts, and cook for his friends on their goat farm.

programme.title: Freshly Picked With Simon Toohey
programme.desc: Hot and spicy is all the rage in today's episode. Rebecca Veale is back in the kitchen for crispy chilli stir fry, and Simon brings a spicy salad loaded with mouthwatering roasted radishes.

programme.title: Jamie's Great Italian Escape
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver arrives on the tiny Sicilian island of Marettimo. Here he meets fisherman Giovanni - the owner of one of Sicily's best restaurants - who has Jamie work as his assistant in his eatery.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: It's a beautifully buttery night on The Cook Up, as Adam is joined by croissant connoisseur Kate Reid and acclaimed chef Giovanni Pilu.

programme.title: Symon's Dinners Cooking Out
programme.desc: This traditional Tuscan dish is perfect for a summer's late lunch to carry you into an evening of relaxing. Michael Symon revamps some grilled chicken by glazing it with some floral vermouth.

programme.title: Paula McIntyre's Hamely Kitchen
programme.desc: Paula shows us how to make her version of steak diane by substituting the steak with a collop of venision which she roasts and serves with sauteed potatoes. She demonstrates how to smoke a chicken.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Vietnam
programme.desc: Chef Luke Nguyen visits the beachside town of Nha Trang, a coastal town abundant with fresh seafood - and prepares char grilled lobster right on the beach.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke heads to a coastal town to teach cooking skills to disabled children, who learn how to prepare fish cakes; Luke visits to a farmyard to learn how a family creates fresh tofu; local monks demonstrate how to cook a vegetarian meal.

programme.title: Planet Bbq
programme.desc: This show gives grilled and smoked vegetables their due; tandoori cauliflower with coriander mint chutney, squash gratin with habanero chiles, and Mexican pit-roasted lamb.

programme.title: Fun'q With Spencer Watts
programme.desc: The sun is shining and Spencer is turning up the heat, cooking delicious grilled food perfect to be served on a bun. He shares his secrets to the perfect grilled veggie burger and sesame meatloaf.

programme.title: Island Echoes With Nornie Bero
programme.desc: Nornie journeys to Hammond Island to explore its unique blend of cultures and rich history.

programme.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programme.sub-title: Grown Up Tomato Soup And Grilled Cheese
programme.desc: This classic combo from your youth gets an adult makeover and will make your mouth water. Rachael shows us her version of a creamy tomato soup and a spicy grilled cheese.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Guest chef Adam D'Sylva kicks off with his delicious Vietnamese Chicken and Bean Salad. Laura follows with Lamb and Feta Koftas with Flatbread and Yoghurt.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia always says, Let the ingredients shine! When you choose quality ingredients, it's best to let them speak for themselves.

programme.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
programme.desc: Hayden learns about regenerative farming at a cherry farm and a cattle property, with alpacas and a famous winery visit thrown in, and ends the day with a picture-perfect campfire meal.

programme.title: Freshly Picked With Simon Toohey
programme.desc: This episode of Freshly Picked is filled with delicious sweet treats. Monica Mignone returns with her carrot cake slice. Simon makes yummy biscuits with maple and tahini.

programme.title: Jamie's Great Italian Escape
programme.desc: Jamie heads north to the mountains of Le Marche - a relatively unexplored region next door to Umbria - to stay with a family of hunters.

programme.title: The Chocolate Queen
programme.desc: Celebrated pastry chef and chocolatier Kirsten Tibballs presents an array of incredibly clever and innovative tricks, tips and cheats to bring the wow factor to home baking.

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programme.desc: Learn how to whip up Justine's delicious homemade sub or her hearty Italian ratatouille on today's episode. Also, ex-Masterchef contestant, Emelia Jackson, drops in.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: Two trailblazing guests, chef Analiese Gregory and hospitality head honcho Ibby Moubadder join Adam in the kitchen to celebrate the power of some simple sides.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick journeys through southern England. He takes in the rather pungent Garlic festival on the Isle of Wight, visits a chilli fiesta, and tastes the once extinct Blue Vinny cheese.
